card.statement:
We study holonomic modules for the rings of invariant differential operators on affine commutative domains with finite Krull dimension with respect to arbitrary actions of finite groups.
We prove the Bernstein inequality for these rings. Our main tool is the filter dimension introduced by Bavula.
We extend the results for the invariants of the Weyl algebra with respect to the symplectic action of a finite group, for the rings of invariant differential operators on quotient varieties, and invariants of certain generalized Weyl algebras under the linear actions.
We show that the filter dimension of all above mentioned algebras equals $1$.

Keywords: Filter dimension, holonomic modules, generalized Weyl algebras, invariant differential operators
2020 Mathematics Subject Classification: 16P90, 16S32, 16D30, 16W70
